content: We need number of carbonyl (C=O) groups in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We can use IR spectra to detect carbonyl stretch, or carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-210 ppm). Use IR first maybe cheaper? Both are cheap but we should minimize. Probably IR is simplest: carbonyl shows strong absorption around 1700 cm-1. Use ir_spectra tool.
